text: raschke: "Test of support close to the average". Nearness to an average is not my test; C11 is buy strength, never weakness. rs_rank_pct 33.52 fails Template criterion 8 and the long averages are flat (C3), and seow has it well off the high. A support test in a name that is not leading is a stage 1 purchase (C2), which my method prohibits. What clears me: rs_rank_pct over 70 with ma100 over ma200, then a breakout that leads its group.
